MEASUREMENT_PROTOCOL_FULLY_SPECIFIED: 1. Build J_diff: for each of n samples and each class c in 1..C-1, one row = grad_theta (logit_c - logit_0).
2. rank = number of singular values of J_diff exceeding 1e-9 * sigma_max.
3. Compare rank DIRECTLY against min(n*(C-1), P-(h_last+1)). No separately estimated gauge probe is used anywhere.
5. float64 throughout; parameters at initialization (the law is architectural, not training dependent).
prediction.falsifier: Any cell where rank != min(n(C-1), P-(h_last+1)).
prediction.pass_criterion: EXACT integer agreement in every cell. A single mismatch fails.
prediction.statement: rank(J_diff) = min( n*(C-1), P - (h_last + 1) )  and  d_free = max(0, P - (h_last+1) - n*(C-1)).
